detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

GHK-Cu

Chemical Information:
  • Molecular Formula: C14H24N6O4Cu
  • Molecular Weight: 340.84 g/mol*
  • *)“GHK-Cu may appear as ~340 Da (peptide only) or ~404 Da (copper complex) depending on MS conditions. The blue color confirms copper is present in the complex.”
  • Sequence: Gly-His-Lys
  • Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

GHK-Cu (glycyl-L-histidyl-L-lysine copper) is a synthetic tripeptide-metal coordination compound composed of a defined three-amino-acid sequence (Gly-His-Lys) bound to a copper ion. The compound is produced through controlled synthesis and metal-complexation processes and is provided exclusively for in vitro research in qualified laboratory settings. GHK-Cu is structurally characterized and utilized in controlled experimental environments for analytical and experimental evaluation of peptide–metal coordination chemistry and associated physicochemical properties. It is supplied in lyophilized powder form to support stability and integrity during storage and handling. This material is not formulated for cosmetic, clinical, diagnostic, or therapeutic use.

Research Applications:

GHK-Cu is utilized in controlled laboratory research settings for applications such as:

  • Analytical evaluation of peptide–metal complex structure and composition
  • Examination of stability and binding characteristics of copper-associated peptide systems
  • Investigation of peptide behavior in biochemical and in vitro assay environments
  • Characterization of interactions between peptide complexes and defined experimental systems
Storage and Handling:
  • Store lyophilized powder at -20°C.
  • Once reconstituted, store at 2-8°C and use promptly.
  • Maintain aseptic techniques during laboratory handling.
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: Blue to blue-green lyophilized powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in suitable laboratory agents
Compliance Notice:

GHK-Cu is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
